headline: Executive order ends COVID-19 vaccination requirements for federal workers.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order moves the federal government away from requiring federal workers to be vaccinated against COVID-19. No summary was provided, so details such as which earlier rules it cancels and whether other groups are covered are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would no longer be required to get a COVID-19 vaccine as a condition of their federal job.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 9, 2023; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
